Thanks for confirming Anna — I'll join as well. For clarity ahead of the call I'm sharing the proposed 30-minute agenda and a condensed MAP so we can assign owners quickly.

Proposed 30-minute agenda (we'll expand if needed):
1) Introductions & objective (3 min) — confirm attendees and what "activation" looks like for GridScale.
2) PO & billing path (7 min) — Karthik will outline the PO timeline, invoice cadence, and any prepayment requirements.
3) Required onboarding documents (7 min) — vendor worksheet fields, tax docs, and a short security pre-screen (if applicable).
4) MAP review & milestone owners (8 min) — confirm milestones, handoffs, and target dates.
5) Next steps & blockers (5 min) — immediate actions and owners.

Success criteria we propose (to discuss):
- PO issued and countersigned by GridScale finance within 10 business days of kickoff.
- Necessary vendor documents (W-9, billing contact, remittance instructions) submitted at least 3 business days before provisioning.
- Initial technical verification and credentials issued within 5 business days after PO execution.

I uploaded a compact Mutual_Action_Plan_v1.xlsx with suggested milestones (onboarding form completion, PO sign, environment provisioning, smoke test). Please review before the call if possible.

Attachments referenced: Mutual_Action_Plan_v1.xlsx (xlsx)

See you at 15:00 PST — Zoom link is the same as the Drive/HubSpot links below.

Laura Bennett
Head, Procurement Operations
Redwood Inference

Great call today — recap and actions below. Thanks everyone for the time.

Recap (short):
- PO path: GridScale to issue PO to Redwood finance (finance@redwoodinference.com). Karthik confirmed standard 30-net terms; finance to confirm final payment terms once PO is received.
- Docs required: completed vendor worksheet, W-9 (US), billing contact, remittance instructions. GridScale will send the packet by EOD Friday.
- Security: no full questionnaire required for initial provisioning; a short pre-screen checklist will be completed before credentials. Security follow-up owned by Security (cc'd on MAP - we'll loop separately if any gaps).
- Onboarding timeline (agreed tentative): PO signed by 2028-11-20, provisioning by 2028-11-27, smoke test by 2028-11-29.

Action items (owners & due dates):
- Anna / GridScale: Send vendor packet + W-9 (due 2028-11-10).
- Karthik / Redwood procurement: Confirm final invoicing address & update PO template (due 2028-11-13).
- Laura: Kick off provisioning once finance confirms; share provisioning checklist (due 2028-11-21).
- Rohan: Update MAP with today's decisions and post to Drive + HubSpot (done 2028-11-09).

Attachments added to thread: GridScale_Vendor_Details.xlsx, Redwood_PO_Template.pdf, Mutual_Action_Plan_v1.xlsx
